bridge.build.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PRETTY_RUN_BEGIN
if [ -z "${PRETTY_RUN:-}" ] && [ -f "$(dirname "$0")/tools/pretty_run.py" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PRETTY_RUN=1 exec python3 "$(dirname "$0")/tools/pretty_run.py" --wrap --mode "${PRETTY_MODE:-build}" -- bash "$0" "$@"
fi
# PRETTY_RUN_END
# =============================================================================
# <REPO> - Incremental build workflow
# Copyright (C) 2026 JuanenRac (Electro Hobby 3D) <electrohobby3d@gmail.com>
# GPL-3.0-or-later - see LICENSE
# =============================================================================
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
trap '[ -t 0 ] && read -r -p "Press Enter to close..." _' EXIT
printf '\n*******************************************************************************\n'
printf '%s\n' '* <REPO> - build.sh' '* Mode      : INCREMENTAL BUILD' '* Author    : JuanenRac (Electro Hobby 3D)' '* Email     : electrohobby3d@gmail.com' '* Copyright : (C) 2026 JuanenRac' '* License   : GPL-3.0-or-later - see LICENSE' '* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *' '* 1. Validate source and deterministic safety tests without mutation.' '* 2. Never change the version: raising it is the explicit bump command.' '* 3. Report the result and keep this terminal open.' '*******************************************************************************'
printf '\n[1/1] Running non-mutating build test...\n'
python3 tools/build_test.py
HYDRA_UMC_VERSION_BUILT="$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("hydra-umc.project.json", encoding="utf-8"))["version"])')"
printf 'BUILD=PASS. Built v%s. Building never changes the version; to raise it run: python tools/hydra_project_tool.py bump\n' "$HYDRA_UMC_VERSION_BUILT"
bridge.build.bat:
@echo off
rem PRETTY_RUN_BEGIN
if not defined PRETTY_MODE set "PRETTY_MODE=build"
set "PRETTY_PY=python"
where py >nul 2>&1 && set "PRETTY_PY=py -3"
if not defined PRETTY_RUN if exist "%~dp0tools\pretty_run.py" (
    set "PRETTY_RUN=1"
    %PRETTY_PY% "%~dp0tools\pretty_run.py" --wrap --mode %PRETTY_MODE% -- cmd /d /c "%~f0" %*
    exit /b
)
rem PRETTY_RUN_END
REM =============================================================================
REM <REPO> - Incremental build workflow
REM Copyright (C) 2026 JuanenRac (Electro Hobby 3D) <electrohobby3d@gmail.com>
REM GPL-3.0-or-later - see LICENSE
REM =============================================================================
setlocal
rem Keep the window open for people, never in automation (CI / HYDRA_UMC_CI).
set "KEEP_OPEN=pause"
if defined CI set "KEEP_OPEN=ver >nul"
if "%HYDRA_UMC_CI%"=="1" set "KEEP_OPEN=ver >nul"
cd /d "%~dp0"
echo.
echo *******************************************************************************
echo * <REPO> - build.bat
echo * Mode      : INCREMENTAL BUILD
echo * Author    : JuanenRac ^(Electro Hobby 3D^)
echo * Email     : electrohobby3d@gmail.com
echo * Copyright : ^(C^) 2026 JuanenRac
echo * License   : GPL-3.0-or-later - see LICENSE
echo * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *
echo * 1. Validate source and deterministic safety tests without mutation.
echo * 2. Never change the version: raising it is the explicit bump command.
echo * 3. Report the result and keep this terminal open.
echo *******************************************************************************
echo.
echo [1/1] Running non-mutating build test...
where py >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (python tools\build_test.py) else (py -3 tools\build_test.py)
if errorlevel 1 goto :error
where py >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 goto :error
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%V in (`python -c "import json; print(json.load(open(r'%~dp0hydra-umc.project.json', encoding='utf-8'))['version'])"`) do set "HYDRA_UMC_VERSION_BUILT=%%V"
echo BUILD=PASS. Built v%HYDRA_UMC_VERSION_BUILT%. Building never changes the version; to raise it run: python tools\hydra_project_tool.py bump
echo.
%KEEP_OPEN%
exit /b 0
:error
echo BUILD FAILED.
echo.
%KEEP_OPEN%
exit /b 1
